description: MAGE couples geospace component models developed through the NASA DRIVE Center for Geospace Storms. The assembled calculation connects magnetospheric plasma dynamics with other parts of the near-Earth space environment. The resource is documented by JHU APL; UCAR. The documented physical domain is Geospace, Magnetosphere / Global Magnetosphere, Magnetosphere / Inner Magnetosphere / RingCurrent, High Latitude Ionosphere / Auroral Region, Global Ionosphere, Thermosphere; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Public Repository, Runs-on-Request. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. Its coupled research models require careful configuration; catalogue access is not evidence of operational forecast performance. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. Only metadata were checked; numerical accuracy and current service availability remain unverified.
